title: Mirror Target v1
description: Frozen execution contract (SW-1510-CONTRACT). Wire record for one repository mirror transfer. ops-engine owns the generic release/mirror machinery and SkillWeave ops owns the org configuration; this schema is the reviewed wire contract they exchange, not a replacement for either. visibility is an explicit enum so a private-to-public change is a validation failure.

visibility.description: Visibility of the existing source; the transfer preserves it.

role.description: Role of the repository in the topology.

names_unchanged.description: Transfer keeps repository names unchanged. A name change is a different, unauthorized operation.

authority_evidence_digest.description: Digest of the owner authorization permitting this repository transfer.
